title: The embodied-agent challenge
description: First place in the NeurIPS 2025 EAI Challenge at the Foundation Models Meet Embodied Agents Workshop, as team AxisTilted2.

title: Research at eBay
description: Joined eBay’s Knowledge Extraction team in April 2024. Researching and building language-model systems for information extraction. Promoted in October 2025.

title: An MS at UC San Diego
description: Completed an MS in computer science at UC San Diego. Worked with Julian McAuley’s group on AI music and language models, and TA’d recommender systems and data mining.

title: Research, made into zines
description: ZINify received an Honorable Mention at the UIST Student Innovation Contest. Experiments with language models and visual storytelling.

title: A startup that didn’t make it
description: Accepted into UCSD’s StartR Rady accelerator with Glyp, a writing assistant for novelists. The project did not make it to market; I wrote about what went wrong.

title: An industry research internship
description: Summer research with eBay’s Knowledge Extraction team, working on information extraction at scale.

title: First of 591 teams
description: Won the eBay University Machine Learning Challenge with named-entity extraction from product titles. The challenge led to the research internship.

title: From hardware to computer science
description: Started the MS at UC San Diego after three years in chip design.

title: Learning to respect silicon
description: ASIC digital design at Texas Instruments, 2019–2022: physical design, RTL, and getting actual chips out of the door.

title: Electrical engineering, and other interests
description: Graduated from NIT Karnataka in electrical and electronics engineering. Deep learning through Kaggle, a thesis on power-quality classification, and the Amateur Astronomy Club.
